description:
arXiv:2609.13155v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Cognitive offloading is the use of external aids, such as notes, calculators, or search engines, to reduce mental effort. title: LLMs Unplugged: Teaching Resources for a ChatGPT World
description:
arXiv:2609.13183v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are everywhere, yet many learners lack a concrete mental model of how they generate text. This paper presents LLMs Unplugged, an unplugged set of activities that teaches the training-to-generation loop (and beyond) using hand-built n-gram models and simple weighted sampling.
